results.answer: Arizona law (A.R.S. 13-3729) adds misdemeanor offenses for operations violating federal aviation rules or interfering with emergency operations and a felony for photographing/loitering near critical facilities in furtherance of a crime; A.R.S. 9-500.55 bars cities from regulating drone operation except e.g. model-aircraft takeoff/landing in city parks. No state drone license, registration or insurance mandate was found in the texts opened; insurance requirements were not verified.

facts.claim: Under A.R.S. 13-3729(A), it is unlawful in Arizona to operate a civil unmanned aircraft if the operation is prohibited by federal aviation law or interferes with law enforcement, firefighter or emergency services operations.
facts.quote: Interferes with a law enforcement, firefighter or emergency services operation.
facts.sourceTitle: A.R.S. 13-3729 Unlawful operation of model or unmanned aircraft

facts.claim: A.R.S. 13-3729(B) makes it unlawful to use a drone to intentionally photograph or loiter over or near a critical facility in furtherance of a criminal offense.
facts.quote: intentionally photograph or loiter over or near a critical facility in the furtherance of any criminal offense
facts.sourceTitle: A.R.S. 13-3729 Unlawful operation of model or unmanned aircraft

facts.claim: A.R.S. 13-3729(G): a violation of subsection A or C is a class 1 misdemeanor.
facts.quote: A violation of subsection A or C of this section is a class 1 misdemeanor.
facts.sourceTitle: A.R.S. 13-3729 Unlawful operation of model or unmanned aircraft

facts.claim: A.R.S. 9-500.55 prohibits Arizona cities and towns from adopting any ordinance, policy or rule relating to ownership or operation of unmanned aircraft, except as otherwise provided by law.
facts.quote: a city or town may not enact or adopt any ordinance, policy or rule that relates to
facts.sourceTitle: A.R.S. 9-500.55 Prohibition on unmanned aircraft regulation; exceptions

facts.claim: A.R.S. 9-500.55 allows cities to regulate takeoff or landing of model aircraft in city-owned parks or preserves under stated conditions.
facts.quote: Taking off or landing a model aircraft in a park or preserve that is owned by the city or town
facts.sourceTitle: A.R.S. 9-500.55 Prohibition on unmanned aircraft regulation; exceptions
